channel.title: Million Dollar Mountain Homes
channel.desc: Rooted in Georgia with a successful plastic surgery practice in Arizona, Doc and Denise are finally looking to slow down and enjoy the fruits of their labor. But with a wish list that includes a gourmet kitchen, a man cave, and five bedrooms each with a private en suite, are the doctor's orders too much to nip and tuck into one home?
